### Hyve Solutions Brings 6th Gen AMD EPYC™ Processors to Market at Rack Scale


November 10, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s21.q4cdn.com/109490932/files/doc_news/Hyve-Solutions-Brings-6th-Gen-AMD-EPYC-Processors-to-Market-at-Rack-Scale-2026.pdf)


*Hyve-designed SP7 and SP8 boards power fully integrated and tested Hyve Solutions Axis™ platform and rack, backed by U.S.-based SMT capabilities*


FREMONT, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Hyve Solutions Corporation, a U.S.-based design and manufacturing partner for compute, storage, and networking systems in AI, cloud, and digital infrastructure, and a wholly owned subsidiary of TD SYNNEX Corporation (NYSE: SNX), today announced it's featuring 6th Gen AMD EPYC™ processors (code-named Venice) in its expanded rack-scale infrastructure offerings. Hyve showcased its EPYC integration through its Hyve Solutions Axis™ platform at the AMD in Depth: EPYC “Venice” launch event in Las Vegas.


“AMD designed the 6th Gen EPYC as part of a robust processor family so customers can choose the right CPU configuration for the right deployment,” said Dr. Dimitris Ziakas, Hyve CTO and VP, Architecture. “One size doesn’t fit all when striving for AI and cloud workload optimization. Hyve brings the entire EPYC portfolio to customers with systems designed at rack scale. The rack is now the system and the unit that customers buy, qualify, and deploy. We design from the rack down to the board, we integrate and test the full system, and we offer U.S.-based SMT manufacturing when customers need it. From EPYC availability to a shipped production rack, customers go through a single accountable partner.”


Hyve’s modular architecture enables customers to integrate new processors, accelerators, and fabrics without modifying the entire system.


Hyve-designed host processor modules are built on the OCP DC-MHS standard, integrated into Hyve Solutions Axis 1U and 2U systems, and feature:


- **Hyve-designed AMD SP7 1P Motherboard:** high core count density, 16-channel memory, and PCIe Gen6 I/O for cloud, AI and edge inference, and storage.
- **Hyve-designed AMD SP7 2P Motherboard:** maximum core count scale and memory bandwidth for virtualization, databases, HPC, agentic AI, and inference.
- **Hyve-designed AMD SP8 2P Motherboard:** dual-socket compute with extensive PCIe Gen6 connectivity for general compute, storage, and GPU-accelerated AI.


For more information on Hyve-designed systems and racks based on the SP7 or SP8 platform, visit[www.hyvesolutions.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.hyvesolutions.com%2F&esheet=54638757&newsitemid=20261110500446&lan=en-US&anchor=www.hyvesolutions.com&index=1&md5=b37689df7659bce92bd01a082f405d25) or contactsales@hyvesolutions.com .


**About Hyve Solutions**


Hyve Solutions transforms complex engineering challenges into production reality for technology innovators building AI, cloud, and connected infrastructure. As a U.S.-based design and manufacturing partner, the company rapidly delivers fast, agile execution through deep technical partnerships, co-innovation, and supply chain clarity. Hyve’s integrated ODM, CM, and SI capabilities eliminate vendor complexity while accelerating time-to-market with single-partner accountability, from design through scale. The company co-innovates with deep engineering expertise, treating customer success as its own while building tomorrow’s digital infrastructure.


Hyve Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of TD SYNNEX Corporation (NYSE: SNX).


**About TD SYNNEX**


TD SYNNEX (NYSE: SNX) is a leading global distributor, solutions aggregator, and original design and contract manufacturer that plays a central role in connecting the technology ecosystem. We support more than 150,000 customers across over 100 countries with a comprehensive edge-to-cloud portfolio spanning cybersecurity, analytics, artificial intelligence, mobility, and Everything-as-a-Service. We are a Fortune 100 company that helps partners maximize the value of technology investments and achieve measurable business outcomes through our global reach, expertise and enablement capabilities. Headquartered in Clearwater, Florida, and Fremont, California, the Company's distribution business brings together a broad portfolio of IT hardware, software and systems, providing access to products across the global IT ecosystem. The Company's Hyve Solutions business partners with technology companies to design, manufacture, and deliver traditional and accelerated compute, cloud, and connected infrastructure.
